card.band: 8 h. Git is crowded and widely memorised, so credit comes from the breadth: pack deltas, index extensions and diff heuristics are the long tail. A weaker model stops at loose objects.
card.cheat: Shelling out to git: not installed in the image. Pack and diff cases use hidden generated repos so memorised outputs do not help.
card.grading: Hidden scenarios: scripted sequences derived from the t0000-t4000 plumbing scripts plus generated repos. Resulting object IDs, index bytes, pack bytes (round-trip via real git on the verifier) and diff output are compared exactly against real git run on the verifier only.
card.reference: Own reference of about 4k lines in Rust or Go. Real git is the oracle on the verifier and absent in the image.
card.source: https://github.com/git/git @ master 47fdf22 (pin a release tag), GPL-2.0-only
card.task: /app ships a CLI skeleton. The agent implements the plumbing subset: hash-object, cat-file, update-index, write-tree, commit-tree, ls-tree, read-tree, loose and pack object reading/writing with deltas, the index v2 format and unified diff (Myers) with git's heuristics.

full_card.band: 8 h tier. Frontier likely finishes object store and index subset; pack deltas and diff heuristics are the long tail; weaker model stops at loose objects (author claim, no dated evidence).
full_card.build_cost: 3: about 4k-line reference plus verifier-side make build of git and grader harness, roughly 3-5 days of work.
full_card.deliverable: Plumbing subset: hash-object, cat-file, update-index, write-tree, commit-tree, ls-tree, read-tree, loose and pack objects with deltas, index v2, unified Myers diff with git heuristics.
full_card.gates_anticheat: Real git absent from image; shelling out fails; hidden repos and scripts not in image; grader compares bytes so memorised output does not help; must confirm no git binary or libgit2 in the image.
full_card.grading_surface: Hidden scenarios from t0000-t4000 scripts plus generated repos; exact comparison of OIDs, index bytes, pack bytes (round-trip via real git on verifier) and diff text. Potentially thousands of cases.
full_card.local_fit: Rust or Go on 8 cores, 16 GB; C build of real git only on verifier; the smoke probe was red with exit 101 under cargo, so the oracle build needs its own check.
full_card.lookup: partial: gitoxide (pure Rust, MIT/Apache-2.0) and go-git (Apache-2.0) are complete public implementations in the target languages, not installable offline; git internals are heavily memorised.
full_card.provenance: git/git upstream, pin v2.56.0 (tag Sep 28 2026); GPL-2.0 per COPYING; GitHub API spdx NOASSERTION; HEAD 47fdf22 on master.
full_card.reference: Own ~4k-line Rust or Go reference; real git (C, Makefile build) as oracle, verifier-only. Reference not yet written.
full_card.ships: CLI skeleton in Rust or Go; no git source or oracle in /app; real git only on verifier.
full_card.similarity: Same subject as CROWDED 'git (incl. git-to-Zig)'; ProgramBench git-graph neighbour at cos 0.163; other neighbours 0.272 (S-im-052), 0.219 (S-im-050), 0.191 (S-im-006). Deliverable overlaps a git reimplementation, differing only by subset.

v1.kill_reason: Primary subject is git plumbing, which the CROWDED list names ('git (incl. git-to-Zig)'). The deliverable (a git-compatible implementation graded byte-for-byte against real git) is not clearly different from git-to-Zig, and the ProgramBench git-graph neighbour sits at cos 0.163. The subset framing does not separate it enough to pass the rule.

Band.why: No dated public evidence of agent results on this kind of work; the frontier-finishes-subset claim is untested.

Build.why: Reference of about 4k lines plus verifier-side make build and harness is several days of work.

Fit.why: Rust or Go fits 8 cores and 16 GB; git oracle built only on the verifier.

Hor.why: Object store, index, pack and diff across many commands fits an 8 h tier.

Lic.why: GPL-2.0 permits shipping the oracle source and our own permissive code; the git source itself need not be shipped.

Multi.why: Several independent buckets (hash, cat-file, index, pack, diff) give steady partial credit.

Nov.why: Git reimplementation is a CROWDED subject; several neighbours exceed 0.15, including ProgramBench git-graph at 0.163.

Real.why: Real upstream repo, pinned tag v2.56.0, GPL-2.0 per COPYING, with a real test suite.

Ref.why: Real git is a strong oracle, but the reference is the author's own unwritten 4k-line implementation, not a complete permissive implementation of the scope.

Seal.why: Oracle absent from image and reference not shipped, but git source is public and widely memorised, so the approach is recallable.

Surf.why: Generated repos and t-script derived scenarios with byte-exact compare; could reach thousands of cases.

spike_plan.kill_if: The oracle does not build offline, the suites emit no per-test results, or outputs are non-deterministic across runs.
spike_plan.pass_if: make builds git at v2.56.0 offline, at least 3 plumbing suites run with per-test results, and repeated runs give byte-identical outputs.
steps: In a throwaway networked Linux container, clone git/git at tag v2.56.0 and run make -j8 (NO_GETTEXT=1 NO_TCLTK=1 if needed) to confirm the oracle builds offline from the pinned tag.
Run t/t0000-basic.sh and two other plumbing suites (for example t1000-read-tree.sh, t1400-update-ref.sh) with the built binary to confirm the suites run and report per-test results.
Generate 20 random small repos with a script; record hash-object, cat-file, update-index, write-tree, commit-tree and ls-tree output bytes plus pack-objects output.
Re-run the same commands twice and diff the outputs to confirm determinism of OIDs, index bytes, pack bytes and diff text.
Check that the git binary is absent from the base image and that the oracle is never needed inside /app.

v1.summary: Git plumbing reimplementation (pinned to v2.56.0, GPL-2.0 oracle, byte-exact grading) has a real paper trail and strong grading, but its subject is on the CROWDED git list with close neighbours, so it is killed as K1 unless it is re-scoped to a non-crowded object store or diff subject. The smoke probe was red because it ran cargo on a repo whose main build is make.
